thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy 'service-api v2.9.1' finished on cluster canary-3 at 2024-04-18T02:07:03Z. Healthcheck: degraded - p99 latency spike detected. @mike_oncall paging.

mike_oncall: I'm on it. seeing increased 5xx and timeouts from canary-3. p95 ~ 1.2s -> 3.6s, p99 ~ 2.5s -> 8.9s. 5xx rate ~ 7% of traffic.

alice (eng): uhh, that was my canary rollout -- rolling back now if needed. any immediate mitigation suggestions?

jordan (sre): quick checks: 1) connection pool exhaustion on gateway? 2) KV cache miss storm? 3) thread stacks for worker process blocking. can you dump recent logs from canary-3?

alice (eng): grabbing logs... tail from pod:

```
2024-04-18T02:06:55Z ERROR http_handler.go:243 request timeout after 10s conn_wait
2024-04-18T02:06:56Z WARN worker_pool.go:112 queue_size=512 latency=1200ms
2024-04-18T02:06:57Z ERROR inference_runtime.go:87 kvcache miss storm keyPrefix=prompt/*
```

mike_oncall: seeing similar in metrics: connection_wait_count spiking, active connections per worker saturated. Looks like async backend calls backing up. Is this thundering-prefix from kv warmup?

jordan (sre): codepath change in v2.9.1 introduced sync blocking call before async spawn. Probably blocking worker thread and causing head-of-line. Can we revert that diff? If not, rollback.

alice (eng): I can revert. initiating rollback to v2.9.0 canary and stopping the rollout to prod.

ops-lead: hold on: what's customer impact? CS on the line? @cs-rep?

cs-rep: getting reports from two customers, some elevated 500s for model generate endpoints. Roughly 8-12% of requests in NA region between 02:06-02:14 UTC returned 502/504. Not yet widespread but trending.

mike_oncall: decision: rollback canary and abort prod cutover. rolling back canary-3 now. alice, perform rollback and post ETA. jordan, watch metrics and be ready to scale or drain.

alice (eng): rollback command issued: `kubectl set image deployment/service-api service-api=service-api:v2.9.0 --record`

deploy-bot: Rollback job started (job id rb-3480011223).

jordan (sre): scaling suggestion in case rollback doesn't help: bump worker pool to 2x, and increase gateway connection pool and keepalive. I'll prepare commands.

mike_oncall: checking telemetry... p99 dropping from 8.9s to 1.1s after rollback started. 5xx rate trending down to 1.1%. Keep watching for residual errors.

alice (eng): rollback completed at 02:13:17Z. verified pods on v2.9.0.

mike_oncall: confirmed: error rate back to baseline ~0.6-1.2%. p95/p99 back to normal. marking incident as mitigated.

ops-lead: good. next: postmortem assigned. alice + jordan to own. include timeline, root cause (sync blocking call), and rollback playbook gaps.

emma_oncall: I'm taking oncall handoff in 20m — will follow up on any lingering alerts. mike, anything to add for handoff?

mike_oncall: notes for handoff: watch connection_wait_count, gateway conn metrics, and kv cache warmup on next deploy; throttle rollout or use smaller canary fraction if KV changed. Also add an automated detector for sudden prefix-miss storms.

cs-rep: informing impacted customers of mitigation and that a postmortem will be shared.

alice (eng): quick patch ready to revert the blocking diff; will run additional unit and integration test for async path, and create canary with zero-traffic dry run first.

jordan (sre): creating runbook entry: temp mitigations (rollback, scale), indicators to watch (p95/p99, connection_wait_count, kv_miss_rate), and escalation path.

deploy-bot: Incident mitigated. Tags: rollback, canary, latency-regression, kvcache, oncall-handoff. Incident closed by mike_oncall at 02:18:43Z.

mike_oncall: closing thread. will reopen if we see reoccurrence. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
